long_description: Local stdio MCP. Requires uv and network to install the SHA-256-pinned 0.8.0 wheel on first launch. DWG requires managed LibreDWG; GIS conversion requires GIS runtime. Optional CAD editing uses a separately installed MIT runtime. No project drawings are bundled.
